<function name="PlayerShouldTaunt" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>Allows to suppress player taunts.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">Player who tried to taunt</arg>
		<arg name="act" type="number">Act ID of the taunt player tries to do, see <page>Enums/ACT</page></arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return false to disallow player taunting</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
